# SCI-NOI v0.1 — NOI-GEN Parent And Operator Graph

Artifact identity: `SCI-NOI_GEN_PARENT_OPERATOR_GRAPH v0.1/r0.4`

Status: ODQ-101 conditioning class, ODQ-102A route, ODQ-102B coherence, and
ODQ-102C network-stratified coefficient-balance family approved; exact finite
design and frozen boundary gates remain unavailable; other route-specific
methods remain unselected and unavailable

## Conditioning Classes

For one fixed-state member `b`,

```text
realization_b = O_Theta0(R_b(parent)).
```

For one relearned member,

```text
Theta_b       = LearnResolve_b(R_b(parent))
realization_b = O_Theta_b(R_b(parent)).
```

`parent` is the earliest immutable object to which assignment operator `R_b`
is applied. `O_Theta0` or `O_Theta_b` is the complete host-operator graph after
that insertion point. Adjacent packages retain ownership of every host
operator. NOI owns the assignment design and GEN product identity.

ODQ-101 approves fixed-state conditional-sign as the ordinary conditioning
class. ODQ-102A selects the exact PTC-to-frozen-MAP route below as ordinary.
Relearned GEN remains unavailable until an owner-approved graph names every
replayed stage, input, learned state, changed-state record, response, lifecycle,
and failure.

Parent numerical coincidence, equal arrays, equal WCS, equal signs, or one
shared assignment law never merges these identities.

ODQ-102B fixes the selected route's coherence map: all admitted PTC occurrences
for one stable realized detector/channel in one observation map to the same
assignment variable. A scan, subscan, sample, time, worker, traversal, or
accumulation boundary cannot change that assignment.

ODQ-102C fixes the selected route's balance family. For every exact observation
and stable readout network, NOI derives each detector's coefficient mass from
the exact frozen MAP-admitted positive `a_pi = G_pi gamma_i` contributions and
balances signed totals within that network only. Cross-network, cross-array,
and cross-observation cancellation is forbidden. The admissible law is
complement-symmetric with detector marginal sign probability `1/2`; count
balance and detector independence after conditioning are not claimed. Exact
finite-design mechanics remain ODQ-102D.

For the selected route, inline application and materialized randomized
timestream application are scientifically equivalent representations only when
they apply the identical NOI modifier to the identical admitted PTC occurrence
before the identical frozen MAP arithmetic. Materialization is never required.
NOI owns the assignment/design and realization identity; MAP owns only
conforming application of the modifier within its frozen accumulation.

## Required Identity For Every Complete Method

Every route-specific method binds:

1. exact method/version and conditioning class;
2. earliest immutable parent package/version/product/application generation;
3. randomized quantity and stable coherence-unit population;
4. exact sign insertion point and assignment-design generation;
5. complete host operator and frozen `Theta_0`, or complete replay graph and
   member-specific `Theta_b`;
6. output quantity, unit, nominal-beam identity, WCS/frame, shape/indexing, and
   support;
7. source content, cancellation target, source-imprint/leakage interpretation;
8. validity, response, covariance, availability, and omitted terms;
9. requested/effective/observation-resolved/applied/realized lifecycle;
10. failure scope, persistence/reconstruction, and immutable provenance; and
11. exact parent-boundary and NOI-owned policy identities.

No later UNC, filter, selection, or STD operation changes an earlier GEN graph
or member. No route description creates a missing parent or upgrades an
unavailable numerical state.
